// diagnostic

E0429

`` `{name}` is not ambient here — this file opted out with `#NoPrelude` ``.

What

`` `{name}` is not ambient here — this file opted out with `#NoPrelude` ``.

Why

`` `#NoPrelude` disables every readable Core prelude name ``.

Fix

Write a qualified Core call, or remove `#NoPrelude`.

Worked example

First UI snapshot mentioning E0429: tests/ui/no_prelude_print.stderr.

Error [E0429]: `print` is not ambient here — this file opted out with `#NoPrelude`
  --> tests/ui/no_prelude_print.jet:4:5
    |
  4 |     print("should fail")
    |     ^^^^^
 Why: `#NoPrelude` disables the curated prelude auto-imports (`print` / `input`)
 Fix: write `use core.term as io` and call `io.print(…)`, or remove `#NoPrelude`
